description: Execute multiple commands in one daemon request. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of steps accepted for this batch.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

out.description: Optional output path for command artifacts.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

steps.description: Structured batch steps. Each step uses a command name and the same input object as that command tool.

command.description: Command name to run with structured input.

input.description: Structured command input for the nested command. Use the matching MCP tool schema for this object.

name: batch
